visualCharacteristics.structure: background image + h2 in green rounded panel

contentPattern: 1 row, 1 cell (picture and heading may also be in separate cells/rows): picture (background photo) + h2 title (any other text stays with the title). Rendered as a full-bleed photo with the h2 in a green panel, rounded on its right edge, over the photo's left side (>= 900px); stacked photo then panel on mobile. The section carries Section Metadata Tab and Id (e.g. Tab: patient, Id: take / Tab: hcp, Id: dosing).
